test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row (not necessarily in the same order) facing towards north. C sits third to the left of E. E is the neighbour of A. Only two persons sit between A and B. Only three persons sit between C and F. Only two persons sit between F and G.

Which of the following seating arrangement cannot be possible (from left to right)?

options.text: C, G, A, E, F, B, D
D, C, G, A , E, F, B
D, B, C, G, A, E, F
B, D, C, G, A, E, F

solution:
Given: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G.

1) C sits third to the left of E. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/632daf128c42712cbb40aa9cc82d50250d0b4dcd36b387641f3babbe958fb117.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92ddf4888305e32242a687fb7d4ac5f84acf4d5fa273f7ccd71f3d715f757f91.png] 

2) E is the neighbour of A. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b34ad1071efdf8b9153e21a5be35c3ef316ee21eb67ea18089c5f6da2d02e114.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42047fb005af3698b794702381c4335a5d6af429f2c47aa553463faa524d8e26.png] 

3) Only two persons sit between A and B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67f03eaa3931bdfb09db4efeb9f9677bdec19fb582477f33681a6c0817ee70a3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f28d474053eb1fe19a57b251ea627b0fd772cc8de700fe5546e2e32d1bb5ae4c.png] 

4) Only three persons sit between C and F.

Here case 2 eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62e402b41707f6db2770bd6c668818a40dead695cc6f91543d44f1727b957112.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc63de3c2f15e5168df562e3169d1c7be7c676bfa0ac2648d61bd028c64d280e.png] 

5) Only two persons sit between F and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/767678da3fe52563725aa298fa064f4ce2239e794cef70ab36632c81ec413530.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68040c9f4583bd716506e123cc4d485623ece66558021145c886cb688f6b8e0a.png] 

Exact position of D is not given.

**Analyze the options: **

1) C, G, A, E, F, B, D - Possible (According to the given information this arrangement is correct because exact position of D is not given.)

2) D, C, G, A , E, F, B - Possible (According to the given information this arrangement is correct because exact position of D is not given.)

3) D, B, C, G, A, E, F - Possible (According to the given information this arrangement is correct because exact position of D is not given.)

**4) B, D, C, G, A, E, F - Not Possible (This statement "Only two persons sit between A and B" does not follow here)**

Thus, this **B, D, C, G, A, E, F** seating arrangement cannot be possible (from left to right).

Hence, the correct answer is "**B, D, C, G, A, E, F".**
